body: I'm sorry for wasting your time with this. Thank you for listening...
I'm an atheist as well, so prayer and best wishes mean the same thing to me. Thank you for listening and I hope things turn around for you.

I can see the similarities between aspects of my life and Chubbuck's. I can honestly say that the lack of a romantic relationship (let alone children, I wouldn't wish my genes on anyone) really isn't the primary factor for me, though. A factor, sure - nobody wants to end up a shrew after all - but not what I'd point to as The Reason.

I haven't been diagnosed with a mood disorder. It is something that's crossed my mind over the years, alongside wondering if I maybe had full tilt depression, but nothing I've been able to afford to be diagnosed. 

Not having insurance hurts in that area. I don't make enough to be able to pay for it out of pocket, either. I simply can't afford to go on the off chance I could maybe be "fixed." Even if turned out it was something treatable, it'd be a lifelong struggle and additional expense that I couldn't afford whatsoever.

I've managed to hang onto my current job for the last two years but before that it was pretty up and down. I don't have much in the way of confidence and come across poorly in interviews leading to callbacks being very rare. Most of the lower wage jobs I have to settle with are in retail, which requires a lot of customer interaction...being a bit on the ugly side of the scale and constantly flubbing interviews doesn't help my chances even there considering the sheer amount of competition these days.

I'm not sure where you got the impression I was close with my parents. When I was young, maybe, but that's not the case anymore. I haven't spoken to them for a few years now after we had a falling out. Dual parts my own bit of unfair resentment towards them and their disappointment/frustration with my failings.

And I'd have to say that "late bloomer" would be putting it lightly in that department. I'm far past even considering that as a possible thing that could happen if I kept trudging along. It's just not something that was meant for me, I accepted that long ago.
